findings.issue: Wrong furigana: 幸福 is read こうふく, not しあわせ (しあわせ is 幸せ). The lesson's own vocab list and exercise 5 accept-list use こうふく, so the body reading contradicts them.
findings.current: <jp reading="きみさえいれば、ぼくはしあわせだ">君さえいれば、僕は幸福だ</jp>
findings.suggested: <jp reading="きみさえいれば、ぼくはこうふくだ">君さえいれば、僕は幸福だ</jp>

findings.issue: European Portuguese clitic placement (enclisis after a subject pronoun); pt-BR requires proclisis: 'Ela se liga'.
findings.current: Ela liga-se sobretudo a substantivos e pronomes.
findings.suggested: Ela se liga sobretudo a substantivos e pronomes.
